hypothesis: Adversarial training of generative models improves output quality
prediction: Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) of generated images
measurement_method: Evaluate PSNR of images generated by models trained with and without adversarial training
falsification_condition: If the PSNR of images generated by models trained with adversarial training is not significantly higher (p-value < 0.05) than those without adversarial training, the prediction is falsified.
